Home.heroSubtitle: One place to find Director, VP, Head of and C-suite roles across engineering, product, design and data in India, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, North Africa, Europe and North America. Real apply links, visa signals, and pay bands in local currency.
Home.featureVisaBody: Each posting is read for sponsorship language and refusals, so you can filter straight to roles that sponsor work visas and skip the ones that say no. Roles tagged by a source board say so.
Home.featurePayBody: Stated salaries are shown as posted. When a posting hides the number, an estimated band from the ExpatRate country benchmarks fills the gap, always labeled as an estimate.
Home.featureApplyBody: Every role links to the employer's own posting. No middlemen, no re-hosted forms, no expired aggregator pages.
Home.sourcesNote: Sourced from official and public job APIs. * marks estimated pay bands. Details on the About page.

About.title: About ExecAtlas
About.intro: ExecAtlas collects senior leadership roles across engineering, product, design and data from official and public job APIs, reads every posting for signals that matter to international candidates, and presents them with filters and local-currency pay context.
About.sourcesBody: Listings come from the public Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby job board APIs, Workable's public job search, the open APIs of Arbeitnow and Jobicy, the Himalayas remote jobs API, and jobs from Adzuna.
About.blockedTitle: Why no LinkedIn, Indeed or Naukri jobs?
About.blockedBody: Those sites do not offer public job APIs and their terms do not allow automated collection. Scraping them is not something this project does. If any of them opens an official access path, a connector slot is ready. Many employers post the same roles on their own Greenhouse or Workable boards, which this site does cover.
About.visaBody: ExecAtlas software reads every posting for sponsorship language such as visa sponsorship or work permit, and for explicit refusals such as not available or must already hold the right to work. A relocation offer on its own is shown as relocation support. Arbeitnow also tags some roles as visa sponsoring. Those pages say so and show the date of the check. Postings that say nothing are marked Unspecified.
About.salaryBody: When a posting states a range, it is shown as stated. Otherwise an estimated band is computed from the country benchmarks of <link>ExpatRate</link>, a free and open salary benchmark project, for senior technology roles, always in the local currency of the job's country, and always labeled as an estimate.
About.limitsBody: Estimates are orientation, not offers. Visa detection reads words, not immigration policy. Some countries have thin benchmark data and will show no estimate. The about page will always be honest about gaps.
